fullContentHtml:
UP Board Class 10th & 12th Time-Table 2027 – Full Details

Short Details : Uttar Pradesh Madhyamik Shiksha Parishad (UPMSP) has announced the Class 10th & Class 12th Board Exam Dates & Time Table for the Session 2026 – 2027. UP Board Class 10th exam will be held from 05 February 2027 to 24 February 2027 and the UP Board Class 12th Exams will be held from 05 February 2027 to 24 February 2027. Candidates need to start preparing well for their Most Important Examination in the Name of Board Examination. All the candidates who had registered for class 10 and class 12 of the year 2026-27 can download their Time Table from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • UP Board Time Table Issued : 13 October 2026
  • Class 10th Annual Exam Date : 05 February 2027 to 24 February 2027
  • Class 12th Annual Exam Date : 05 February 2027 to 24 February 2027

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Click on the official Admit Card link given below.
  2. Login using your Application Number / Roll Number and Password / DOB.
  3. Your Admit Card will be displayed on screen.
  4. Download the PDF and take a clear printout to carry to the exam venue.

Important Links

  • Download Exam Time Table
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is UP Board Class 10th & 12th Time-Table 2027?

UP Board Class 10th & 12th Time-Table 2027 is the official hall ticket for the upcoming examination. Candidates must carry it along with a valid photo ID to the exam centre.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
